name: Sealer + Clear - int_door_slab
intent: Sanding sealer + clear topcoat with interstage sanding. Both layers fire through the same TSK_DOOR_BRUSH/SPRAY keepers; the material_type per task_ref selects the appropriate TRADE_MATERIAL factor (WB_SEALER_BRUSH/SPRAY for the sealer pass, WB_CLEAR_BRUSH/SPRAY for the clear pass).
doctrine: Sealer+clear for int_door_slab. Interstage sanding required for stain/clear. NO roll for clear. QT3=0+1, QT4=1+2, QT5=2+3. Universal-keeper migration 2026-05-11: TSK_DOOR_SEALER_BRUSH/SPRAY + TSK_DOOR_CLEAR_BRUSH/SPRAY (4 tasks) collapsed into TSK_DOOR_BRUSH/SPRAY (2 keepers). The brush variants get 0.9× time (clear/sealer apply faster than paint when brushed); spray variants are 1.0× (sprayer doesn't care about coating viscosity). Current rates 6 sides/hr for spray clear/sealer drift to 10 sides/hr effective post-migration — accepted per the 'rates later' calibration deferral.
